name: Daily Cross Word Neon
author: Addicting Games
description: Daily Crossword is the online version of your favorite newspaper puzzle. Show off your dictionary knowledge with a daily dose of crossword puzzles. Tune in every day for a different crossword puzzle to solve. Look to the lefthand panel, and use the scrollers to look up and down the lists for the rows and columns of each word on the board. The objective of a crossword puzzle is to figure out the word based on the number of slots available and using the definition or hint available. Fill in all the slots with the correct words to win this online game. Finished the game and you want more? Click on the date to play previous dates or play future dates.
